entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Sa te byen pase?" t="Did it work?" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Bon, mwen  panse ….....se yon gwo vanse…....Sa pral pi fasil pou nou kounye a… En Hen, En Hen..." t="Well, I think… It's a great implant… It'll be easier now… Uh-huh, uh-huh..." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Ann vanse sou sa … Sa enpòtan anpil … Non… Nou pa bezwen sa… Se fanmi nou ye." t="Let's go in on it… It's important… No… No need… We're family." b="" a=""/>
